name: Apache ECharts
description: Render styled Apache ECharts data charts locally as separate downloadable SVG and PNG artifacts, ready for PDF or Word documents.
progressive_guidance: Create charts with native ECharts JSON options and grounded data. Use one charts entry per requested chart. No provider, browser or account is required. Default styling provides readable light/dark charts; override titles, axes, series and labels through ECharts options. Rendered files are static image artifacts, not interactive session components. Use returned charts paths to embed SVG/PNG assets with typst image/figure or document.create sections.images. Use SVG for sharp PDF figures and PNG for broadly compatible image downloads.

render.description: Render a batch of named charts as separate SVG/PNG artifacts using Apache ECharts.
render.progressive_guidance: Use actual supplied/retrieved values and state their units. Never invent data. For bar/line: set xAxis.type=category with labels, yAxis.type=value and series with type and data. For pie: use series.type=pie with named values. Provide useful title.text, series names and labels; position legends away from titles and pie labels. Native ECharts dataset, grid, axis, label and series options are supported as JSON; formatter strings use ECharts template syntax, not executable functions. Animations are disabled for complete static exports. Image resources are unsupported. Request only the owner-selected formats, or both when SVG for documents and PNG for previews are useful. Inspect PNG or rasterized SVG with file.readImage before delivery; fix clipping, unreadable labels or misleading scales. Each chart-format pair returns its own path and artifact.

name.description: Descriptive name mapping the chart to the owner request.

option.description: Native Apache ECharts JSON options: title, dataset or series data, axes, legend, labels and styles. No JavaScript functions or image resources.

formats.description: Requested image formats; defaults to both. Select only png for PNG image requests.

width.description: Logical chart width in pixels; profile default is 960.

height.description: Logical chart height in pixels; profile default is 540.

pixelRatio.description: PNG resolution multiplier; profile default is 2. SVG remains vector.
